company.name: Minly
company.shortDescription: Minly is an online platform for celebrities and fans to connect through a new form of personalized experiences.
company.description:
Minly is an online platform for celebrities and fans to connect through a new form of personalized experiences. Minly makes impossible connections possible. They help bridge the gap between celebrities and their fans.

With so many people facing unprecedented hardships today, Minly helps give fans access to unforgettable experiences from their favorite stars.

Minly is a platform where fans can request personalized video shoutouts from their favorite actors, singers, athletes, influencers, and more. Fans can surprise their friends or loved ones for any occasion, whether it’s a birthday, anniversary, graduation, or just because.

Minly’s positive impact doesn’t end here — we have also partnered with a few local non-profit organizations focused on feeding, development, and social development in the region.

Minly Ltd. provides the Minly service – website, iOS, and Android apps – to users in the Middle East region and globally.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $3,600,000, or 84.21% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,971,742 to $20,460,793, a 4.12x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
